articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, and video inputs with a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates significant improvements in long-horizon planning tasks and multi-step mathematical proofs, narrowing the gap with specialized formal verification tools. Enterprise API access began rolling out in late April with tiered pricing based on context utilization.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2, which sets new records on GPQA-Diamond, MathOdyssey, and a newly introduced materials science benchmark. The model leverages a mixture-of-experts architecture with over 2 trillion parameters and demonstrates emergent capabilities in hypothesis generation for protein-ligand binding prediction. Google is integrating the model directly into its Cloud Vertex AI platform for research customers.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Demonstrates Autonomous Warehouse Operations at Scale
articles.summary: Figure AI showcased its Figure 03 humanoid robots operating autonomously across a 200,000 sq ft logistics warehouse, handling picking, packing, and palletizing without human intervention for continuous 8-hour shifts. The system uses a vision-language-action model fine-tuned on warehouse teleoperation data, achieving a 97.3% task success rate. BMW and Amazon have reportedly signed expanded pilot agreements for Q3 2026 deployments.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Enters Limited Production with Dexterous Manipulation Upgrade
articles.summary: Tesla announced that its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot has entered limited production at its Austin facility, featuring 27 degrees of freedom in each hand and a new tactile sensing array enabling fine-grained object manipulation. The robots are initially being deployed in Tesla's own factories for cable routing and small-parts assembly. Musk stated the company aims to produce 10,000 units by end of 2026 with external sales beginning in 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Oversight Framework for Enterprise Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new framework enabling enterprises to deploy Claude-based autonomous agents with layered constitutional constraints, real-time audit logging, and human-in-the-loop escalation policies. The system allows organizations to define domain-specific behavioral constitutions that govern agent actions in production environments such as finance, healthcare, and legal workflows. Early adopters report a 60% reduction in required human oversight compared to previous guardrail approaches.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its N14P (1.4nm-class) process node has entered volume production at its Kaohsiung fab, approximately one quarter ahead of the original roadmap. The node uses gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery, delivering an 18% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2. Apple, Nvidia, and Qualcomm are confirmed first customers, with chips expected in consumer devices by early 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum published results showing sustained fault-tolerant operations on 32 logical qubits with error rates below 10^-6 per logical gate cycle, using Quantinuum's latest trapped-ion hardware and Microsoft's qubit virtualization layer. This crosses a key threshold that makes certain quantum chemistry simulations practically viable for the first time. The team demonstrated a simulation of a FeMo-cofactor electronic structure that would be intractable on classical hardware.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Next-Gen Atlas with Seamless Loco-Manipulation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics revealed a major update to its electric Atlas platform, demonstrating seamless transitions between bipedal locomotion, crouching manipulation, and single-arm lifting of 30kg payloads in unstructured construction environments. The robot uses a unified transformer-based policy trained in simulation and transferred zero-shot to hardware, eliminating the need for task-specific motion planners. Hyundai confirmed deployment trials at its Ulsan shipyard beginning in June 2026.
